policy: Discover documented public APIs only. Never scrape private endpoints, bypass authentication, or ingest media without documented distribution rights and adult consent.

sources.playback: Search results can reference videos from services such as YouTube; playback remains on the original provider and must follow its terms
sources.rightsGate: Search listing is not a redistribution license; verify each creator's rights and embed permission

coverageNotes.KR: Kakao Daum provides an official video-search API returning metadata from video services such as YouTube. This is discovery metadata only, not permission to re-host media. Naver video inclusion requires partnership submission and structured VideoObject/creator pages; no public general Naver video-search endpoint was verified.
coverageNotes.VN: YouTube Data API supports search with regionCode=VN and authorized creator/channel workflows. Results are metadata and official embeds, not blanket rights to re-host user videos.
coverageNotes.OTHER: Additional countries can be added through the same provider contract after documentation, authorization, playback and takedown requirements are verified.
